summary.name: EdrawMind (Edraw MindMaster)
summary.one_liner: EdrawMind is a mind mapping and knowledge management tool for building mind maps, notes, and diagrams with AI-assisted structuring and cross-device sync.
use_cases: Turning notes or documents into structured mind maps
Planning projects with Kanban or Gantt views
Building org charts, timelines, and fishbone diagrams
Preparing client presentations with AI-generated slides
summary.what_it_does: EdrawMind lets users create mind maps, concept maps, tree diagrams, fishbone diagrams, org charts, and timelines. Its Mind Map Agent builds editable maps from a prompt, file, webpage, or existing map. Nodes can have full documents attached, and AI can produce outlines and summaries. The page lists 52 themes, 30 layouts, custom color schemes, and hundreds of built-in shapes and icons. Ideas sync across desktop, web, mobile, and tablet, and the page mentions collaboration, Kanban and Gantt charts, AI PPT generation, and Pitch Mode.
notable: Mind Map Agent builds editable maps from prompts, files, webpages, or existing maps
Full document attachments on mind map nodes with AI outlines and summaries
Kanban, Gantt, AI PPT generation, and Pitch Mode
caveats: Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; the meta description calls it free, but paid features are not specified
Page is largely marketing with few technical specifics such as exact platform list or export formats
